_comment: GitHub repository ruleset for main-branch protection. Apply via `jq 'del(._comment)' .github/branch-protection-ruleset.json | gh api -X POST /repos/<owner>/<repo>/rulesets --input -`. The `_comment` key is stripped before apply because the GitHub Rulesets API rejects unknown top-level fields. The two `Analyze` contexts below require CodeQL to be enabled for the repo (GitHub Advanced Security is free on public repos; CodeQL on private free-tier is disabled, so expect those contexts to appear only after public flip at Phase 1.8.2).
name: main branch protection
